propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Concede, quaesumus, Ecclesiae tuae, omnipotens Deus: ut beatum Stephanum
Confessorem tuum, quem regnantem in terris propagatorem habuit,
propugnatorem habere mereatur gloriosum in caelis. Per Dominum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Respice, quas offerimus, hostias, omnipotens Deus: et praesta; ut, qui
passionis dominicae mysteria celebramus, imitemur quod agimus. Per eundem
Dominum.

translations.caution: Original study translation; not approved for liturgical use or recitation.
translations.text: Almighty God, look upon the sacrificial offerings we bring, and grant that we who celebrate the mysteries of the Lord's Passion may imitate what we enact. Through the same Lord.
